hypothesis: The existing coarse structure refiner was stopped after only three full-data epochs while wall F1, opening F1, and watertightness were still rising; extending the same architecture to eight epochs can improve structure without changing room predictions.

baseline.note: Internal structure resolution; final explicit-plan metrics are reported separately.

decision_rules.continue: Extend to 24 total epochs or plateau if wall/opening/watertight metrics continue improving.
decision_rules.conditioning_mismatch: The first five-epoch extension used dense room logits and did not improve end-to-end wall/opening metrics; this next arm uses the query-routed room control that is actually deployed.
decision_rules.add_new_loss: Only after the eight-epoch continuation is evaluated; target wall precision, opening recall, then graph metrics separately.
decision_rules.reject: Do not reject before the five-epoch continuation completes and the later checkpoint trend is inspected.

outcome.reason: The five-epoch continuation plateaus and does not improve end-to-end wall or opening F1.
outcome.next_route: Reuse the existing wall-centerline and opening-interval representations as separate layers; do not collapse them into the room raster.

gates.screen: Wall precision >= 0.55, opening F1 >= 0.30, Node F1 >= 0.85, edge F1 >= 0.65, GED improves on cal64 and holdout64.
gates.safety: Validity 1.0, wall continuity >= 0.95, functional watertightness >= 0.95, plan plausibility >= 0.95.
gates.matched: Use the same case order, evaluator, room path, and decode as the current safe-routing candidate.
